headline: Castagna Downplays the "Preliminary" Agreement with Crédit Agricole
summary: Banco BPM's chief executive Castagna said the preliminary agreement with Crédit Agricole is not closed. Anima remains a red line for the deal, according to the report.
why: Banco BPM is an Italian listed bank, and Crédit Agricole is a major French banking group, so their combination talks would reshape Italian and European banking consolidation.
why_moved: The market reacted to comments that the preliminary agreement is not closed, per the report. Anima's status is described as a red line for the deal.
